newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France office blasted by bomb in Nice.
newsitem.headline: Air France office blasted by bomb in Nice.

text.p: A powerful bomb ripped though the offices of the national Air France airline in this main Riveria city late on Tuesday causing extensive damage but no casualties, police said on Wednesday.

There was no immediate indication who was responsible but the mode of operation was similar to that of Corsican separatists who have made several attacks in south French cities since a recent police crackdown against them.
Several neighbouring offices and parked cars were seriously damaged while the airline office in central Nice was virtually wrecked, police said.
